title: Nationals - Aaron Maher (AUS) vs Ryota Yoshiba (JPN)
tactical_note: Aaron Maher's grappling in this match involves a combination of standing and ground/scrumble elements, with a significant level change shot and a mean spine lean. The elbow flexion and knee flexion are also notable. This match highlights Maher's ability to control the level change shot and maintain a balanced posture.
